story.retrieval.lockdown: The facility channels Spark toward containment. Capture checkpoints and service shafts stand between the escaped specimen and open air.
story.retrieval.ascent: Retrieval patrols cross the towers above the city. Spark climbs toward the clouds, searching for a route beyond their reach.
story.retrieval.graveyard: Among abandoned satellites, containment equipment still glows. Spark wonders what else these machines once held.
story.retrieval.null: Something here feeds on light. Spark must find a way through the darkness and keep moving.
story.retrieval.containment_exit: The vessel is behind Spark, but the facility has begun a retrieval cycle. Deeper corridors lead toward the surface.
story.retrieval.ascent_exit: The search lights vanish into cloud. Spark enters the storm, where wind and charged air replace the patrols below.
story.retrieval.orbit_exit: The satellite lanes end in wreckage. Among the broken machines, old containment systems still hold their light.
story.retrieval.moon_exit: The lunar relay points around the far side. Earth slips from sight as Spark follows a signal beyond the reach of its captors.
story.retrieval.belt_exit: The fragments thin behind Spark. The unfamiliar creatures fade into the distance, leaving only a faint current of light ahead.
story.retrieval.nebula_exit: A patch of darkness moves against the surrounding glow. Something is feeding here, and Spark must pass without becoming its next light.
story.retrieval.null_exit: Spark leaves the hungry darkness behind. Ahead, a familiar beacon answers; for a moment, it feels like home.
story.retrieval.false_exit: The beacon is a relay, repeating another place’s call. Its answer opens a route into an ancient transit network.
story.retrieval.network_exit: The network carries Spark to its central mechanism. Its repeating patterns hold the answer to where the signal began.
story.retrieval.homeward_exit: Across the last distance, luminous fields come into view. Lights gather beyond the arrival gates, waiting to answer Spark.
storymoments.the_glass_falls_away_for_th: The glass falls away. Spark is beyond the vessel, but alarms are calling the retrieval systems awake. Somewhere outside, a familiar signal still calls.
storymoments.help_spark_find_his_way_out: Help Spark find his way out of the lab. Pull farther to add power, then release to launch.
storymoments.the_breach_has_triggered_th: The breach triggers a retrieval alert. Ahead, a moving gate seals the corridor to keep Spark inside.
storymoments.watch_the_opening_move_rele: Watch the opening move. Release when your path will be clear.
storymoments.spark_slips_into_a_service_: Spark slips into a service passage. A rotating security arm sweeps across his only way forward.
storymoments.wait_for_the_arm_to_pass_th: Wait for the arm to pass, then throw through the open space.
storymoments.the_facility_is_tracking_sp: The facility is tracking Spark. Security beams sweep across the checkpoint, searching for the escaped energy.
storymoments.watch_the_beams_and_their_t: Watch the beams and their timing. Aim through a clear gap.
storymoments.bulkheads_lock_behind_spark: Bulkheads seal behind Spark. The facility is channeling its escaped specimen toward containment again.
storymoments.read_the_nearest_obstacle_f: Read the nearest obstacle first, then check the path beyond it.
storymoments.a_way_out_lies_just_ahead_b: A way out lies just ahead. Beyond the final security system, the city waits under an open sky.
storymoments.take_your_time_find_a_safe_: Take your time. Find a safe path through both obstacles.
storymoments.spark_has_escaped_his_vesse: Spark has broken out of the vessel. The facility wants its specimen back; every open passage is a chance to stay free.
storymoments.spark_has_left_the_laborato: Spark reaches the rooftops, but the retrieval alert has followed. Patrol routes cross the way upward; the familiar signal calls beyond them.
storymoments.spark_climbs_the_city_s_hig: Spark climbs into the storm above the search lights. Wind and charged clouds obscure the pursuit, but each opening demands careful timing.
storymoments.earth_curves_below_an_orbit: Earth curves below an orbital transfer facility. Spark follows the signal along its service platforms. Pressure irises and climb rings regulate the launch route; satellite reflectors offer another way through.
storymoments.beyond_the_transfer_facilit: Beyond the transfer facility, abandoned satellites circle Earth. Loose booms swing across the service route. Spark follows the signal from one surviving Jump Gate to the next, toward the Moon.
storymoments.spark_reaches_a_deserted_lu: Spark reaches a deserted lunar relay. Small lights gather near the outpost, drawn to its glow. Beyond human reach, Spark is still not alone.
storymoments.the_lunar_relay_points_beyo: The lunar relay leads into a belt of fractured rock. Unfamiliar life stirs among the fragments, drawn to Spark’s light. Every clear lane is temporary.
storymoments.beyond_the_belt_the_jump_ga: Luminous clouds answer with a familiar rhythm. Spark follows the glow, unaware of something darker feeding between the lights.
storymoments.the_silent_relay_opens_a_ro: The silent relay opens a route into an ancient network. Its moving apertures respond to the same pulse Spark carries within him. He must reach the central mechanism to understand where the signal began.
storymoments.the_key_has_revealed_luma_a: The Key has revealed Luma. Across the final gates, luminous structures echo Spark’s own energy. Familiar challenges guard the route, but now he knows where he belongs.
storymoments.watch_the_rotating_arms_lau: Watch the rotating arms. Launch through the space they leave behind.
storymoments.follow_the_moving_opening_a: Follow the moving opening and time your release.
storymoments.watch_the_beams_and_wait_fo: Watch the beams and wait for a clear path.
storymoments.the_opening_expands_and_con: The opening expands and contracts. Wait for enough room to pass.
storymoments.aim_for_where_the_ring_will: Aim for where the ring will be when Spark reaches it.
storymoments.the_suspended_counterweight: The suspended counterweight swings across the route. Let the weight and arm pass before you launch.
storymoments.the_amber_eyed_drone_follow: The amber-eyed drone follows an orbit. Watch its loop, then launch past it.
storymoments.rock_fragments_drift_across: Rock fragments drift across the route. Aim around their solid silhouettes.
storymoments.a_red_field_with_an_x_is_ac: A red field with an X is active. When the surface and X disappear, the field is open.
storymoments.the_amber_opening_moves_and: The amber opening moves and changes size. Aim through its clear center; the shutter sectors are solid.
storymoments.the_transfer_facility_switc: The transfer facility switches between two pressure-lock lanes.
storymoments.a_sideways_rock_stream_guar: A sideways rock stream guards a cluster that expands and contracts.
storymoments.an_ancient_aperture_guards_: An ancient aperture guards a row of energy columns. Spark must predict both rhythms.
storymoments.a_turning_plate_and_energy_: A turning plate and energy columns share the final route toward Luma.
storymoments.rooftop_shutters_retract_th: Rooftop shutters retract, then slam shut. Cyan: open. Amber: warning. Red: slam. Time Spark’s arrival.
storymoments.top_and_bottom_panels_now_c: Top and bottom panels now close the opening. Watch where Spark will arrive.
storymoments.the_shutters_open_twice_the: The shutters open twice, then pause. Learn both windows before committing.
storymoments.each_shutter_has_its_own_cl: Each shutter has its own clock. Your shot must clear both at their arrival times.
storymoments.do_not_trust_the_first_clos: Do not trust the first close.
storymoments.the_panels_partially_close_: The panels partially close and reopen before the warning and full slam. Read the complete pattern.
storymoments.the_two_panels_close_slight: The two panels close slightly apart. Watch both edges of the safe opening.
storymoments.cyan_open_amber_warning_red: Cyan: open. Amber: warning. Red: closing. Time Spark’s arrival.
storymoments.spark_has_escaped_the_lab_b: Spark has escaped the lab, but the rooftops have their own security. The city shutters retract, pause, then slam shut. Spark must commit before the opening disappears.
storymoments.cyan_means_open_amber_warns: Cyan means open. Amber warns of the slam. Aim for the gap when Spark arrives, not when you release.
storymoments.spark_is_crossing_the_orbit: Spark is crossing the thin air above the transfer platforms. A circular pressure iris guards the approach; beyond it, a climb ring drifts across the route to the blue portal.
storymoments.wait_for_the_openings_to_al: Wait for the openings to align. Aim through the cyan iris, then the climbing ring, into the blue portal.
storymoments.spark_discovers_a_surface_t: Spark discovers a surface that returns his light. The marked face can redirect him toward the signal.
storymoments.follow_the_complete_guide_t: Follow the complete guide through both cyan faces, then into the Jump Gate.
storymoments.aim_where_the_panel_will_be: Aim where the panel will be at impact. The guide predicts its movement.
storymoments.aim_at_the_cyan_face_the_di: Aim at the cyan face. The diamond marks the bounce; follow the outgoing path to the gate. The dark back and frame are solid.
storymoments.spark_encounters_a_new_barr: Spark encounters a new barrier on his journey. Take a moment to watch how it moves.
storymoments.the_path_changes_ahead_spar: The path changes ahead. Spark pauses to study the unfamiliar machinery before moving closer.
storymoments.the_last_bulkhead_falls_sil: The last bulkhead falls silent. Spark reaches open air, but retrieval signals are already spreading across the city. Freedom lies beyond the search.
storymoments.follow_the_signal_across_th: Follow the signal across the rooftops.
storymoments.spark_reaches_the_highest_r: Spark reaches the highest roof. Retrieval patrols still cross the climb ahead; above them, weather towers disappear into cloud.
storymoments.watch_the_gusts_and_moving_: Watch the gusts and moving rings as you climb.
storymoments.spark_clears_the_storm_eart: The storm swallows the last search lights. Spark climbs toward an orbital transfer facility, leaving the retrieval patrols below.
storymoments.its_pressure_shutters_open_: Its pressure shutters open and close. Find the timing that carries Spark through.
storymoments.the_final_transfer_lock_ope: The final transfer lock opens. Earth’s retrieval signals fade behind Spark. Ahead, silent satellites mark a route toward the Moon.
storymoments.watch_the_swinging_equipmen: Watch the swinging equipment before crossing the orbital graveyard.
storymoments.beyond_the_drifting_wreckag: Beyond the drifting wreckage, a lunar relay answers Spark’s pulse. It is not the source, but it offers a path onward. Spark turns toward the quiet surface.
storymoments.the_outpost_s_antennas_and_: The outpost’s antennas and gravity pockets will change the route of each throw.
storymoments.on_the_far_side_the_signal_: On the far side, the signal sharpens. A dormant Jump Gate wakes beneath Spark’s light, connecting the lunar outpost to a distant trail of shattered rock.
storymoments.choose_a_clear_lane_through: Choose a clear lane through the moving debris.
storymoments.spark_slips_beyond_the_last: Spark slips beyond the last tumbling fragments. Through the next gate, vast clouds pulse with the rhythm he remembers. The signal is stronger than ever.
storymoments.the_energy_fields_ahead_bec: The energy fields ahead become passable only during their quiet phase.
storymoments.spark_reaches_the_heart_of_: Spark reaches the heart of the glow—and the signal falls silent. No other lights approach. This place has been repeating a message from somewhere else. As Spark answers it, the relay reveals a path into an ancient network.
storymoments.follow_the_newly_opened_rou: Follow the newly opened route. The source is still beyond it.
storymoments.the_central_mechanism_recog: The central mechanism recognizes Spark’s pulse. Its rings align into a map, tracing the signal back to a luminous world: Luma. For the first time, Spark sees the way home.
storymoments.the_destination_is_now_reve: The destination is now revealed on your journey map.
storymoments.you_were_never_the_only_lig: You were never the only light.
storymoments.spark_crosses_the_final_gat: Spark crosses the final gate. Lights rise from the luminous fields to meet him, each answering with the pulse he has carried all this way. The distant signal becomes a chorus. Spark is home.
storymoments.your_escape_is_complete_end: Your escape is complete. Endless Voyage lets Spark explore the open network freely, with home always waiting.

newencounters.a_dense_lunar_fragment_ben: A dense lunar fragment bends the route toward itself. Spark can use its pull to curve around the rock.

newencounters.the_gravity_pocket_is_stro: The gravity pocket is stronger on this side of the relay.
newencounters.allow_for_the_pull_toward_: Allow for the pull toward the right. Keep Spark clear of the solid rock at the field’s center.

newencounters.check_both_streams_spark_n: Check both streams. Spark needs a clear gap at each arrival time.
newencounters.fragments_spread_outward_t: Fragments spread outward, then converge again around the route.
newencounters.launch_through_the_center_: Launch through the center while the rocks spread. Their return closes the corridor.
newencounters.two_debris_clusters_breath: Two debris clusters breathe at different rates.

newencounters.columns_of_condensed_energ: Columns of condensed energy emerge from the nebula, then fade back into it.
newencounters.bright_filled_columns_are_: Bright filled columns are solid. Dim outlines are passable. Amber warns that a column is returning.
newencounters.a_second_row_of_energy_col: A second row of energy columns follows a different rhythm.
newencounters.find_a_route_through_both_: Find a route through both rows. A quiet column may be solid again before Spark arrives.
newencounters.an_ancient_plate_turns_an_: An ancient plate turns an off-center opening around its axis.
newencounters.follow_the_amber_aperture_: Follow the amber aperture. Aim where the opening will be when Spark reaches the plate.
newencounters.two_ancient_plates_rotate_: Two ancient plates rotate in opposite directions.
newencounters.wait_for_a_route_through_b: Wait for a route through both amber openings, then commit to the shot.
newencounters.three_mechanisms_form_one_: Three mechanisms form one timed passage through the network.
newencounters.pass_all_three_apertures_i: Pass all three apertures in one flight. Each opens in sequence; power changes your arrival timing.
newencounters.luma_s_approach_repeats_th: Luma’s approach repeats the sequence at a quicker rhythm.
newencounters.watch_all_three_gates_aim_: Watch all three gates. Aim through the entire passage and adjust power to match its rhythm.
